WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS transaction_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    transaction_count,
    1.0 * transaction_count / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM trader_type_counts
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(transaction_count) AS total_count,
    AVG(transaction_count) AS average_count
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(s.transaction_count) AS sum_of_counts,
  AVG(s.share) AS average_share,
  AVG(s.transaction_count - summary.average_count) AS average_excess_count
FROM shares AS s
CROSS JOIN summary
WHERE s.transaction_count > summary.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: The requested one-row result is the aggregate over trader types above the average count; the distinct-transaction counts and shares are intermediate values used for that calculation.
